knownAuthorityDebt.title: Legacy verifyPayment() gateway side effects
knownAuthorityDebt.description: All 5 gateway verifyPayment implementations mutate payments.status and bookings.deposit_status outside Payment Authority. Dead code for bot I've Paid paths (converged in PR #160/#169) but still reachable from payment-success page fallback.
knownAuthorityDebt.risk: Latent dual-write if any future refactor re-imports verifyPayment for state mutation

knownAuthorityDebt.title: Non-idempotent handlePostCompletion side effects
knownAuthorityDebt.description: Loyalty points award (post-completion.ts:202-296) has no durable per-payment marker. Referral generation (post-completion.ts:367-396) checks for pending referral but has no UNIQUE constraint. increment_customer_visit visit counter has no idempotency marker.
knownAuthorityDebt.risk: Replay after sideEffectsMayHaveOccurred can double-award loyalty or double-count visits
